v4_controller.base: Exp36 v2 settings: mu_BG=0.005, guard 10 meV, binary step 30 meV, desired clip +/-220 meV, 5-confirmation stop, 20-round cap, same kernel/readout/sweeps.
v4_controller.active_safety_solve: Every actuator solve starts with the scalar objective, finds background sites whose delta violates frozen G-baseline safety bounds (n0=1: delta <= -e_i-3 meV; n0=0: delta >= -e_i+3 meV), adds those rows as weighted bound targets, and multiplies violated-row weights by 5 per iteration (start 1, cap 1000, at most 10 iterations). Bounds come only from the pre-control G census/relaxed state and calibrated W, never from verification samples.
v4_controller.ablation: SEG-SS1-U disables both mu_BG and active safety rows, preserving the no-background-protection comparison.
